admission.justification: Spans schema.py, fts.py, and build.py, is guarded by test_ix_fts_is_deterministic_and_excludes_retired_closed_and_history, and provides the deterministic full-text index backing bounded knowledge_read search queries.

applicability: Derived SQLite knowledge index construction under INDEX_FORMAT ar-knowledge-index/v8.
conditions: Declares ix_fts as an FTS5 virtual table with tokenize='porter unicode61' over record_id, kind, title, statement, conditions, and applicability.
Populates ix_fts in deterministic record_id order strictly from live records, excluding history files, retired invariants, and closed weaknesses without altering canonical memory JSON schemas.
Ranks FTS5 queries with column weights, exact-phrase boost, per-term coverage counts, and deterministic record_id tie-breaking.
exclusions: Does not write any SQLite file into a Git memory working tree or change canonical knowledge file formats.
statement: The derived SQLite knowledge index deterministically builds an ix_fts FTS5 virtual table using porter unicode61 over live records only, excluding history, retired invariants, and closed weaknesses without changing memory-repo schemas.
title: Derived index builds deterministic Porter FTS5 ix_fts over live records
